captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a live rear axle assembly featuring a central, spherical differential housing in black. Extending from either side of this central housing are two black axle tubes, each terminating in a silver-colored wheel hub with mounting studs. Perpendicular to the axle span, a silver pinion input shaft with a u-joint yoke extends forward. The pinion shaft and both wheel hubs are designed to rotate continuously relative to the fixed axle housing.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a live rear axle assembly. It must feature a dark-colored central differential housing, two lateral axle tubes, a silver pinion input shaft with a yoke, and two silver wheel hubs. Define continuous rotational joints for the input shaft and both wheel hubs relative to the main axle housing.
captions.factory: Construct the main axle housing by combining a sphere for the central differential, a cylinder for the pinion snout, and two long cylinders for the axle tubes. Create the pinion input shaft using a cylinder for the shaft and a box with a slot cut out for the yoke. Model the wheel hubs using cylinders for the main hub bodies and smaller cylinders for the mounting studs. Define three continuous joints: one rotating the pinion shaft along the longitudinal axis, and two rotating each wheel hub along the transverse axle axis.
